id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

name.description: What it is called from here: nobody else's in the workspace, case and spaces aside, so it may be numbered, `Scout 2` (ADR 0091). With a person as the actor, a person named it, and its harness no longer renames it.

state.description: `archived` when the thing it is was put away in its harness (ADR 0087, rule 9), or a person archived it (ADR 0095); `active` when it came back. With a person as the actor, its harness archives or restores its side.

face.description: The face a person chose for it (ADR 0089): a mark from Chips' library and the index of the ground it sits on, one for everybody in the workspace. `null` when the choice was taken back and it wears its initials again. Written by Chips for a person; a harness does not send it.

letters.description: One or two letters, or an emoji or two, the face wears on its ground in place of a mark (ADR 0139); the mark is empty beside them. Absent on a face that is a mark, or only a colour.

lead.description: Whether it is its harness's Main agent from here (ADR 0183): `true` when the harness registered it as Main, `false` when its default agent took Main from it. A harness has one at most.

description: An agent was renamed, archived or brought back in its harness, made or no longer its harness's Main agent, or renamed or given a face by a person. What it said stays its, under the new name and face.
title: AgentUpdated
